name: North Country Sportswear
old_description: Looking for a specific item or just browsing for ideas? North Country Sportswear is your one-stop shop for promotional products and business gifts. Our extensive range of promo products will ensure you find something to suit your requirements.
about:
North Country Sportswear is based in Minot, North Dakota. The company has not disclosed its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

The business provides promotional products and corporate gifts, backed by in-house screen printing and embroidery capabilities as well as e-commerce store creation and order fulfillment. Its product line spans thousands of SKUs, including drinkware such as the Shake-It compartment bottle, custom printed apparel, blankets, tech accessories, and a variety of household items. The company also offers a virtual sampling tool for clients to preview designs.

The company lists health care and pharmaceutical organizations among its served industries. Its marketing materials also highlight collections tailored for banking, sports, awards and recognition, travel, and trade-show promotions.

According to its own description, North Country Sportswear differentiates itself through high-quality merchandise, fast turnaround times, pricing that fits various budgets, and the application of promotional-product expertise to deliver customized recommendations for each client.
